summary: Steven Madden, Ltd. filed a routine Form 8-K reporting third-quarter fiscal 2026 results under Item 2.02 and, under Item 8.01, a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share payable December 24, 2026 to holders of record December 11, 2026. No transaction, ownership stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary earnings release and dividend declaration, not a special situation; the only forward item is the record/payment date and the sustainability of the payout.
